name: Maori
intro: The Maori (New Zealand) night sky is similar to the Polynesian night sky, but differs enough to warrant its own sky culture. Maritime themes are central to the Maori sky culture and were used extensively in nautical navigation. Like for most other sky cultures, the rising and setting of prominent stars were used to signal planting and harvesting seasons.
authors: This sky culture is a contribution of Stellarium user Dan Smale
